messages:
alex_prod: NexaLogix just pushed an ETA change for the H100 top-up. New ETA is +5 business days for the bulk. They propose split: 12 urgent units by air, remainder by sea. Also flagged 12 units as RMA replacements that need depot routing. Can we decide split vs consolidate?
jess_ops: Split sounds safer for the RMAs but customs in FRA has been tricky — splitting increases paperwork and brokerage.
sophie_vendor: Apologies — carrier had a manifest error. Two options: A) Air 12 urgent (ETA +2 days), sea rest (ETA +21 days). B) Consolidate overnight air for all at +1 day at extra $12k. We can provide serialized manifest within 24h.
mike_logistics: Overnight $12k vs fragmented customs risk. If air prevents degraded racks being down for >24h it's probably worth it. cc @linda_finance
linda_finance: Quick back-of-envelope: each lost day of capacity ~ $18k in equivalent cloud spend + potential SLA credits. If overnight saves >1 day, approving $12k is a net positive.
ian_infra: Cluster update: 9 degraded GPUs across 3 racks. 12 urgent units will restore roughly 3 racks. Note: eu-west-1 fabric has residual congestion until rebalancer finishes.
alex_prod: Sounds like leaning to overnight for all or at least air for the 12 urgent and sea for the rest. Which gets us out fastest operationally?
sophie_vendor: We can action air for the 12 within 24h if you amend the PO and accept an insurance addendum. For the overnight consolidate option we need final sign-off in 2h to secure the courier slot.
jess_ops: If we do air for 12, confirm RMA flow: direct depot swap vs returns-first? We prefer depot-to-depot for speed.
sophie_vendor: We support direct depot-to-depot swaps for urgent RMAs if depot signs a waiver. Standard RMAs still follow returns-first. I'll mark the 12 as "direct-swap" in docs.
mike_logistics: We need a manifest CSV mapping serials to target depot and node IDs. Please use format below:
```
AWB,serial,target_depot,replacement_serial
AWB123456789,HSN1-A1000,FR-DE-3,REP-000112
AWB123456790,HSN1-A1001,FR-DE-3,REP-000113
```
alex_prod: :thumbsup: Also confirm incoterms and who covers brokerage for air vs sea. Customs delays in FRA can add 48h.
sophie_vendor: Incoterm for air leg: DDP (we cover brokerage). Sea leg we'd request DAP unless you accept port fees. We'll push DDP for the urgent air to avoid brokerage hold.
linda_finance: DDP for air is acceptable. DAP for sea fine as long as amended invoice shows breakdown. Sophie, send updated invoice with line items for overnight courier, insurance, and taxes.
ian_infra: Operational note: when nodes arrive, please do a staged canary join to avoid large rebalance storms. We'll set rebalancer to 10% traffic ramp for new nodes.
jess_ops: Who signs depot waiver? Ops can sign for FR-DE-3 but legal needs to OK liability language. @olivia_legal please advise.
olivia_legal: Send waiver draft. We cannot sign depot-to-depot w/o serial escrow terms and a vendor liability clause until installation acceptance. Quick redline: vendor retains liability until final intake checklist is signed.
sophie_vendor: We can accept escrow clause and update the waiver. Draft welcome.
alex_prod: Next steps: 1) Sophie to amend PO + upload invoice + CSV manifest 2) Olivia to review/quick redline waiver 3) Ops to greenlight depot signature after legal 4) Finance to approve overnight cost once invoice uploaded. Aim: finalize within 3h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
linda_finance: Approving provisional overnight spend pending final invoice.
mike_logistics: I'll reserve courier slot and prep intake form for FR-DE-3.
deploy-bot: Deploy planned: canary rebalancer set to 10% after new nodes join. CI run queue: 3 -> OK.
sophie_vendor: Uploading PO amendment & draft invoice: https://files.nexalogix.com/PO/amend/175.pdf 
alex_prod: Thanks — we'll review and confirm ASAP.
